# BeautifulSoup Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/beautifulsoup-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/beautifulsoup-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.1.12**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Crawls websites using raw HTTP requests. It parses the HTML with the BeautifulSoup library and extracts data from the pages using Python code. Supports both recursive crawling and lists of URLs. This Actor is a Python alternative to Cheerio Scraper.

## Pricing

Free — you pay only for the Apify platform usage (compute units) of the run.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/beautifulsoup-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-beautifulsoup-scraper@0.1.12#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      startUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startUrls` | array | yes |  | Start URLs — A static list of URLs to scrape. |
| `maxCrawlingDepth` | integer |  | `1` | Max crawling depth — Specifies how many links away from the Start URLs the scraper will descend. Note that pages added using context.request_queue in Page function are not subject to the maximum depth constraint. |
| `requestTimeout` | integer |  | `10` | Request timeout — The maximum duration (in seconds) that processing a single page may take before it times out. This limits the request handler that runs your Page function. |
| `linkSelector` | string |  |  | Link selector — A CSS selector stating which links on the page (<a> elements with href attribute) shall be followed and added to the request queue. To filter the links added to the queue, use the Link patterns field. If the Link selector is empty, the page links are ignored. Of course, you can work  |
| `linkPatterns` | array |  |  | Link patterns — Link patterns (regular expressions) to match links in the page that you want to enqueue. Combine with Link selector to tell the scraper where to find links. Omitting the link patterns will cause the scraper to enqueue all links matched by the Link selector. |
| `pageFunction` | string | yes |  | Page function — A Python function, that is executed for every page. Use it to scrape data from the page, perform actions or add new URLs to the request queue. The page function has its own naming scope and you can import any installed modules. Typically you would want to obtain the data from the con |
| `soupFeatures` | string |  | `"html.parser"` | BeautifulSoup parser — The parser BeautifulSoup uses for each page (its features argument). Naming a specific parser keeps results consistent across platforms. Only the parsers bundled with this Actor are available. |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | yes | `{"useApifyProxy":true}` | Proxy configuration — Specifies proxy servers that will be used by the scraper in order to hide its origin. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
